welcome.title: Most people who sell things online had no idea how, either.
welcome.body: You don't need a product, a plan, or a clue where to start. Answer a couple of questions in your own words and we'll show you what's actually out there.
welcome.meta: A minute or two · no right answers

shared.title: First — what's your name?
shared.subtitle: The one you'd want customers to know you by.

shared.title: Where are you right now?
shared.subtitle: This decides where the app opens and what it shows you first.

options.label: I'm starting my own business
options.hint: Even if that's all you know so far. We'll open in Discover.

options.label: I already have a business
options.hint: Skip the exploring — we'll open in Growth, where your customers are.

prompts.title: Pick a question to answer.
prompts.subtitle: Whichever one you've got an answer to. Which one you pick tells us as much as what you write.
prompts.subtitleSecond: Pick a different angle this time — it's the last thing we'll ask.

options.label: What do you lose track of time doing?
options.lead: Whatever you'd do for free, someone is charging for.

options.label: What have you always wanted to try?
options.placeholder: the thing you keep circling back to
options.lead: You keep circling this for a reason. Here's the low-risk version of it.

options.label: What do people come to you for help with?
options.placeholder: what your friends always ask you about
options.lead: People already trust you with this. That's the part most businesses never get.

options.label: What could you talk about for an hour?
options.placeholder: and people have had to stop you
options.lead: That's not a hobby, that's expertise. It's the thing customers can smell on you.

options.label: What's the last thing you made with your hands?
options.lead: You've already made something. Most people never get that far.

options.label: What's stopped you from starting before?
options.placeholder: money, time, not knowing where to begin…
options.lead: Fair. So let's start with something that asks almost nothing of you.

options.label: What's the part that worries you most?
options.placeholder: the bit that makes you hesitate
options.lead: Then here's the smallest possible version — one you could quit tomorrow with nothing lost.

options.label: What would make this feel worth it?
options.placeholder: what would make you say it worked
options.lead: Let's put a number on that.

options.label: What would you do with an extra $500 a month?
options.lead: $500 is closer than it sounds. Here's what it actually takes.

models.MATERIALS: You'd make these yourself. The materials are the only thing you risk.
models.MAKE_YOUR_OWN: You'd make these yourself, from scratch, on your own schedule.
models.DROPSHIP: You'd never touch these. A supplier ships them straight to the buyer.
models.WHOLESALE: You'd buy a batch cheap and sell them on, one at a time.
models.PRINT_ON_DEMAND: You just design it. A printer makes and ships it when someone buys — you hold nothing.

product.closer: No shop. No staff. No permission needed.

already.chapter: You're further along than you think
already.closer: The skill is the hard part, and you have it. The rest is just knowing where to stand.

unblock.chapter: Let's take that off the table
unblock.closer: Nothing to buy up front, nothing to store, nothing to lose if you stop.

math.closer: Not a fortune. But it's real, and it's arithmetic — not luck.

reveal.mathTemplate: Clear about ${margin} a sale. That's {count} sales to reach $500.
reveal.fallbackNote: Not sure yet? Most people aren't. Here's one anyway.
reveal.closerSecond: That's two completely different ways in — and there are 47 more waiting in Discover.

have.title: What do you sell?
have.subtitle: In your own words. The more specific, the better we can find your people.
have.placeholder: e.g. handmade stoneware mugs and bowls for coffee people

have.title: Who buys from you?
have.subtitle: Picture one real person. Skip it if you're still working that out.

have.title: Welcome, {name}.
have.body: {biz} is set up. Growth is already pointed at the communities where your customers spend their time.

new.title: Welcome, {name}.
new.body: Discover is tuned to what you said. Nothing's decided yet — go look at what's possible, and the rest unlocks from there.

finish.note: Anything you skipped lives in the You tab — add it whenever you like.
